//: CUDA OOM when generating 1000+ game decisions. Scaled per model.

decoding.//: T=0.7 balances steering sensitivity with coherence. T=1.0 was too high —
under heavy steering the model produces garbled/unparseable output (coh<0.6).
max_new_tokens=64 gives the model room to produce a parseable answer even when
steering makes it verbose; 32 was too short and truncated mid-answer.

sweep.//: Added 1.5 and 2.0 — lower coeffs preserve coherence while still steering.
The high-coh configs (coh>0.6) cluster at c=10-20, but c=1.5-2.0 may give
coh>0.8 with moderate aggression, which is a better tradeoff for the final eval.
